before.name: William Holmes Borders
before.description: The Reverend William Holmes Borders was pastor of Atlanta’s Wheat Street Baptist Church and a leader of the Love, Law and Liberation Movement. Police arrested him on January 10, 1957 after he and five other Black ministers deliberately rode in seats reserved for white passengers to test Georgia’s bus-segregation law. He was fingerprinted and released on $1,000 bond that day.
